title: Japan 30-Year JGB auction (¥600bn anticipated) — the third super-long tenor in one month, which is what the taper question actually needs and has never had
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,187 bytes) by the jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25 initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 10, 2026 | 30-year'. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: no November row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09, and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-11-03. ¥600bn is the anticipated base case from a second MOF primary, the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, re-parsed 2026-09-09), which shows the 30-year sold at ¥600bn at every auction from 2026-04-07 through 2026-07-07 after ¥700bn through 2026-03. Filed estimate on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), off MOF's own November calendar. It sits D-15 from the proposing event, outside the +/-5-day corridor, and is proposed anyway for one specific measured reason: November 2026 is the first month on this calendar to carry all three super-long JGB tenors — 30-year 11-10, 20-year 11-18 (already proposed as jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18), 40-year 11-25 — inside fifteen days of one another. Every BoJ-bucket test this calendar has run so far (jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 proposing it, jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 refuting it, jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25 retiring the design) has had to month-match auctions across different weeks and different yield regimes, and the proposing ledger's headline finding is that the resulting comparison is confounded by MOF's own issuance schedule, which moved -44.6% at the 40-year against -18.8% at the 20-year over the same window. Three tenors inside one fortnight is the closest this calendar can get to holding the regime fixed, and it costs nothing to track: the 30-year is the arm the calendar currently lacks in November. It is also the near leg of the 30s40s spread that jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 registered a forward test on (FT-jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29-3, scored 2026-12-31), which stood at +0.4bp on 2026-09-08 — the 1.7th percentile of 4,606 sessions. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reasons all sibling JGB ledgers record: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
